content.text: Bɛɛ Libɑniɡibu, i bɛɛn kɔnnɔsu kɛniɔ
kpɑ dɔ̃ɔ u bɛɛn dɑ̃ɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ sɛduru di.
Bɛɛ dɑ̃ɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ sipɛrɛ, i weeweenu koowo.
Be bɑ tii sue mi, bɑ kpeerɑ.
Bɛɛ Bɑsɑnin dɑ̃ɑ bɑkɑnu, i weeweenu koowo.
Domi dɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ ɡe bɑ ǹ dɑɑ kpɛ̃ bu du ɡɑ wɔrukɑ.
domi Yuudɛnin dɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔn bɛɛrɛ yɑ kpɑ.

content: Amɛniwɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Sɑkɑri sɔ̃ɔwɑ. U nɛɛ, ɑ yɑ̃ɑnu kpɑro ni bɑ koo ɡo.
Be bɑ nu dwemɔ bɑ ɡoomɔ bɑ ǹ bu sɛɛyɑsiɑmɔ. Be bɑ mɑɑ nu dɔrɑmɔ bɑ mɔ̀, bɑ nɛ, Gusunɔ siɑrɑ, domi bɑ ɡobi mɔ. Nin kpɑrobu bɑ ku rɑ mɑɑ kɑ nu yinɛ.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ǹ mɑɑ tɔmbun wɔnwɔndu mɔ̀ tem mɛ sɔɔ. Kon bɑɑwure bɛriwɑ win winsim nɔmuɔ kɑ win sunɔn nɔmuɔ. Bɑ koo ben tem ɑrumɑni ɡurɑwɑ. Nɑ ǹ mɑɑ bu wɔrɑmɔ ben yibɛrɛbɑn nɔmun di.
Yerɑ Sɑkɑri u yɑ̃ɑnu kpɑrɑbu wɔri ni bɑ koo ɡo. Yɑ̃ɑ niyɑ nu kɔ̃suru bo. Mɑ u kpɑrɑ dɛki yiru kɑsu. U tiɑ sokɑ durom, tiɑ mɑɑ nɔɔ tiɑ. Mɑ u dɑ u yɑ̃ɑ ni nɔɔri.
Suru tiɑn bɑɑ sɔɔ u nin kpɑrobu itɑ ɡo. Mɑ u kɑ nu tii kpɑrɑ u tɛmɑnɑbu kpɑnɑ. Mɑ nin tii nu nùn tusɑ.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ ǹ mɑɑ nu kpɑrɑmɔ. Nin ni nu koo ɡbi, nu ɡbio. Ni nu koo mɑɑ tiɑrɑ nu tennɔ.
Mɑ u win dɛkɑ ye u sokɑ durom bɔɔkɑ u kɑ sɔ̃ɔsi mɑ u win ɑrukɑwɑni kusiɑ ye u rɑɑ kɑ bwesenu kpuro bɔkuɑ.
Yen tɔ̃ɔ terɑ u ɑrukɑwɑni ye kusiɑ. Mɑ yɑ̃ɑ kɔ̃su ni nu nùn mɛɛrɑ mi, nu ɡiɑ mɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɑriyɑ yi koorɑmɔ.
Mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, yɑ̀ n bu wɛ̃re, bu nùn kɔsiɑru wɛ̃ɛyɔ, yɑ kun mɑɑ bu wɛ̃re, bu derio. Yerɑ bɑ sii ɡeesun ɡobi tɛnɑ yĩirɑ bɑ nùn kɔsiɑ.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ sii ɡeesun ɡobi tɛnɑ ye bɑ mɛɛrɑ burɛ mi, mɔmɔ wɛ̃ɛyɔ. Mɑ u ɡobi yi suɑ u yɑri Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ yi kɑ ko mɔmɔɡii.
Yen biru, u mɑɑ win kpɑrɑ dɛkɑ yiruse ye u sokɑ nɔɔ tiɑ mi, bɔɔkɑ u kɑ sɔ̃ɔsi mɑ Yudɑbɑ kɑ Isirelibɑn bɑɑ sɔɔ nɔɔ tiɑ mɑɑ sɑri.
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ kpɑro nɡe kpɑro ɡɑri bɔkɔ.

Domi kon kpɑro ɡoo seeyɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ, wi u kun yɑ̃ɑnu nɔɔrimɔ ni nu ɡɔɔ dɔɔ. U ǹ nin binu kɑsum dɔɔ. U ǹ ni nu mɛɛrɑ wɑ tim kuɑmmɛ. Mɛyɑ u ǹ mɑɑ ni nu bwɑ̃ɑ do nɔɔrimɔ. Adɑmɑ u koo ni nu ɡum mɔn yɑɑ tem sere kɑ nin kɔ̃riɔ.

content.text: Bɔ̃rurowɑ kpɑro ɡɑri bɔkɔ wi u yɑ̃ɑnu derimɔ.
Tɑkobi yu win ɡɑ̃seru kɑ win nɔm ɡeun nɔnu kɔsukuo,
kpɑ ɡɑ̃se te, tu ɡberɑ kpɑ nɔnu ɡe, ɡu ɡbi.
